reviews.t: Just wish it were different colors- I hate pink and the pink one was bleeding pretty bad ...

I recently ordered another pair and the quality has gone down drastically. The brush that comes with it is now flimsy and practically garbage. The elastic band on both my head wraps snapped within two weeks of buying them! I will not be ordering this brand again.

Literally use one, then when it gets soaked, take it off and put on the other one. All in all, I'm a little disapponted but it works better than a regular old towel.

reviews.t: Not good for my hair. Does not dry at all.
reviews.x: I have thick, long hair, and I always leave my hair so they get dried naturally. So I thought a turban towel would be nice. What surprised me the most about these towels is that they do not dry my hair, even after three hours of wearing them. From the description and the reviews, the microfiber material is supposed to get the hair dried faster than a cotton towel, but in my case this is not true. Also, the loop on the pink towel got torn on the second use. I like the comb though.

I don't usually write reviews, but I really really like these towel wraps. I have long hair and was tired of having a huge towel on my head. These are nice and lightweight but still accommodate long hair. My only con would be that when I first received the wraps, the pink had already bled onto the white wrap. I haven't washed it yet, so I'm not sure if it will come out.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the wraps soft, lightweight, and effective at absorbing water and drying hair quickly.
Several reviewers report the elastic loop or fastener broke or came undone after only a few uses.
Some reviewers with thick or long hair say the wraps do not dry their hair well and they need to use both wraps.
Reviewers praise the secure button fastening that keeps the wrap in place without needing to balance a bulky towel.
A few reviewers mention the pink wrap bled color and wish more color options were available.
